title: Branch coverage floor under vitest 5
context: Moving root vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 to 5.0.5 (FR-14) changes how branches are counted: coverage-v8 5 maps coverage through the source AST, so ?? / ?. / && / default values become branches. Full run, same code, same tests (all green except the changeset guard that the changeset commit fixes): vitest 3 = statements 97.76, branches 95.57, functions 98.92, lines 97.76; vitest 5 = statements 97.50, branches 93.43, functions 98.31, lines 97.87. The 100% src/stage-evidence/** floor still passes. Only the 95% global branches floor fails (93.43). The extra ~304 uncovered branches are spread over about 100 files (largest: cli/commands/module-decisions.ts 20, module-map.ts 16, onboard.ts 16, module-health/rollup.ts 14); only 68 sit under 'v8 ignore next N' hints, which coverage-v8 5 no longer reads as line counts. NFR-3 forbids lowering a floor silently, so the owner decides.
